intro: An MCP server over streamable HTTP that runs Python a model wrote, or a whole project's build and tests, in a container made for that one call, with no network, a read-only root, no capabilities and hard limits, under gVisor.

`sandbox_run_python` takes the whole program, the task's files it reads, and how long it may take; `sandbox_run_tests` takes a project as a tar or tar.gz of its working folder and restores, builds and tests it; `sandbox_diagnose` runs nothing and says whether the node could.

families.title: Running code and tests in a sandbox
